description: Liquefaction Triggering in Subduction Zones is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Gonzalo Montalva, University of Concepcin (udec.cl). To allow the study of liquefaction triggered by subduction earthquakes, this database presents more than 200 sites with recorded surface manifestation of liquefaction, or absence of it. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: liquefaction, site characterization, subduction earthquakes. Published 2021-07-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
